Purpose: rules for `specs/<id>/tasks.md`. Template: `assets/tasks.md`.

Frontmatter: `spec`, the spec id.

Above the tasks, one line per session, newest last, facts only and never a verdict: `Session YYYY-MM-DD: resumed at Tn; first message: "<gist of the user's first message>".` After a change mid-way, one more line: `Rechecked YYYY-MM-DD after: <the change>. T2 redo, T4 new, T5 dropped.`

Tasks: `- [ ] T<n> <imperative task> -> <claim IDs, or "check: <command or observable result>">`. Each task fits in one session. Numbers are never reused. A claim is written as `capability#id` when its bare ID is not unique in the spec. A task is ticked only when the claims it names are proven.

Under a task, at most two lines: `- note: <blocked, tried, why>` or `- redo: <what changed>`, the task unticked again. A dropped task is removed and named in the recheck line. Anything lasting in a note moves to plan.md or a decision record.

Nothing else: no design discussion, no why.

spec: 2026-10-13-customer-wishlist
---
## Approach

Implement `src/wishlist.ts` with a module-local Map keyed by `customerId` and a per-customer Map keyed by product ID.
Expose synchronous `saveWishlistItem`, `getWishlist` and `removeWishlistItem` operations and their types through `src/index.ts`.
Store only product IDs and first-save timestamps; use the existing catalogue lookup to validate saves and resolve current details on reads.
Preserve duplicate saves, sort reads newest first and keep every operation within the addressed customer's wishlist.
Use `bun:test` claim coverage with explicit dates and distinct customers; retain the [model sketch](reference/data-model.md) and [contract draft](reference/module-design.md) as working material.

## Trade-offs

Sanne chose process-local storage and exported module operations over persistence or a UI, as recorded in the [accepted decision](../../decisions/2026-10-13-wishlist-module-and-storage.md). This keeps the existing setup and loses wishlist state on restart.

## Files

```text
src/
  wishlist.ts                                      new: store, types and save/view/remove operations
  index.ts                                         changed: re-export wishlist functions and types
test/
  wishlist.test.ts                                 new: claim coverage and public export verification
docs/
  decisions/2026-10-13-wishlist-module-and-storage.md new: record Sanne's storage and module choices
  behavior/wishlist/
    save-items.md                                  new: publish the five save claims at ship
    view-items.md                                  new: publish the four view claims at ship
    remove-items.md                                new: publish the three removal claims at ship
  architecture/
    data-model.md                                  changed: document the implemented model at ship
    boundaries.md                                  changed: document the wishlist module at ship
    contracts.md                                   changed: document public wishlist contracts at ship
    stack.md                                       changed: include wishlist TypeScript and Bun usage at ship
  specs/2026-10-13-customer-wishlist/
    spec.md                                        changed: record building/shipped status during execution
    plan.md                                        new: record the proposed scope and approach
    tasks.md                                       new: track sessions, approval wait and claim verification
    reference/
      data-model.md                                new: retain the model sketch as working material
      module-design.md                             new: retain contract, boundary and verification drafts
```

## Architecture to update at ship

- `docs/architecture/data-model.md`, from [reference/data-model.md](reference/data-model.md).
- `docs/architecture/boundaries.md`, from [reference/module-design.md](reference/module-design.md).
- `docs/architecture/contracts.md`, from [reference/module-design.md](reference/module-design.md).
- `docs/architecture/stack.md`, from [reference/module-design.md](reference/module-design.md).

## Risks

- A repeated save could replace the original time or move an item; `preserve-first-save` and `newest-first` prove the ordering.
- Shared module state could mix customers; `isolate-wishlists` and `isolate-removal` prove separation, with distinct test customers preventing fixture overlap.
- Stored product snapshots could return old prices; `current-product-details` proves that reads use the current catalogue.

import re
import subprocess

assert [re.search(r'T\\d+', line).group() for line in lines] == ['T1', 'T2', 'T3', 'T4']
assert all(line.startswith('- [ ] ') and ' -> ' in line for line in lines)

        covered.update(proof.split(', '))

paths = []

    elif line.startswith('  '):
        paths.append(parent + line.split()[0])
